title: Active comparator
summary: Assign baseline-adjusted analysis tables for first eligible initiation of either of two exposure classes. ITT follows the selected initiation; on-treatment follow-up additionally requires an active index-arm course at entry and censors at its end plus grace or the first opposite-arm course starting from entry. The tables carry the declared treatment source. These are study design tables; the recipe performs no confounding adjustment.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
